title: QUDIT-LOG2: explicit vector decoding at squared-logarithmic depth

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s, n=ceil(log2N), the SINGLE QUDIT-LOG2 algorithm reproduced in proof.md and qudit_decoder.md recovers the full secret with unconditional probability>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal coset copies. Main n>=2^48 uses exact finite rational RLOG, m=ceil(RLOG(n)^2), actual-width tapered trees, explicit Clifford+T frequency-bin/Fourier vector data measurements, per-root Ct, ONE global fine-attempt capA=4Lblk, fixed selected Qcap=Ct*(Kc*(Y+6+E)+A)+Kp and raw Qbank=1024Qcap including ALL discards/padding. All physical odd/twoadic and finite exhaustive branches are reproduced. Every source,failed/missing/retried root,abort,lookup,address,bit operation,compiler/circuit generation,initialization,gate,measurement and reset is charged; all four bounds hold JOINTLY on EVERY branch. F(n)=n/(log2n)^2+(1/2)(log2n)^2 is the complete exact exponent. Resource logarithms usepositive n2 envelopes atn1. Total charged work O(n^3 (log2n) 2^F(n)), exact growthindex1.
